exposure: Infants not exposed to maternal preeclampsia
cohort: 1152 infants born before 30 weeks gestation and admitted to a tertiary-level neonatal intensive care unit between 1998 and 2014
finding: Fetal exposure to preeclampsia was associated with a decreased rate of severe intraventricular hemorrhage in very preterm infants.
birth_weight: The PE group had a lower median birth weight (795 [262] g) than the background group (890 [385] g).
